correctness.rationale: Weighting by Z is exactly the marginal from planting an increasing subsequence at a uniform k-set of positions. Under the base law, permuting entries inside each consecutive block preserves the restricted count of increasing subsequences using at most one position per block. Hence its conditional expectation on prescribed internal orders is unchanged. On the descent events this restriction contains every increasing subsequence: the cases have one block of length 2, one block of length 3, or two disjoint blocks of length 2. Excluding forbidden marked-position sets by elementary counting gives all stated one- and two-point probabilities. For separated positions y/x is zero when k=2 or 3, and for 4≤k<n is the product (k-2)/(n-2) times (k-3)/(n-3), strictly below x=k(k-1)/(n(n-1)); hence the separated covariance is strictly negative unless k=n, when the permutation is the identity. The variance sum uses n-2 adjacent pairs and (n-2)(n-3)/2 separated pairs. Independent symbolic factorization gave the submitted variance, and exact planted position/value enumeration checked all probabilities, means and variances for 4≤n≤7, 2≤k≤n (python3 /workspace/branches/independent-checks/check_descents.py). The variance/n limit follows by scaling the polynomial as n tends to infinity, including α=0,1. These finite checks do not replace the general proof or give a CLT.

evidence: For a set J of required original descents, form consecutive blocks by joining positions across boundaries in J, including singleton blocks. Let ℓ_1,…,ℓ_m be their lengths. By Eq. (4.1), the monomial coefficient for composition (ℓ_1,…,ℓ_m) counts complemented shuffles with descent set contained in the cut positions, precisely the required event.
In e_k h_1^{n-k}, that coefficient is (n-k)! times [t^k]∏_r(1+ℓ_r t)/∏_r ℓ_r!, by choosing the k distinct variables in e_k. Divide by n!/k! to get the exact probability.
Lengths (2,1,…), (3,1,…) and (2,2,1,…) give respectively the submitted formulas, with common factor 1/2, 1/6 or 1/4. The variance is the sum of those elementary covariances.

value.rationale: The change in separated-descent dependence is a meaningful interpretation, and the formulas are convenient. But the exact pair probabilities are routine coefficient specializations of a known stronger descent distribution principle, and the covariance sign, total variance and variance limit then require only elementary arithmetic. The submission does not isolate a further nonmechanical statistic or structural conclusion.
